thread:
maria: Starting canary for release v2.14.3 — pushing 2024-03-23. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Deploybot kicking off now. @deploybot please annotate runbook.

deploybot: Deploybot: Canary started on infra-canary-eu-west (50 req/s). Tasks: migrate cache prefix, pin model v2.14.3. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/deploy-unwind (steps + quick links).

sam: Noted. @ops can you prep backout? If latency > 120ms or error rate > 2% we abort. :thumbsup:

nina: Prepped. Backout checklist in runbook has DB toggle + traffic revert + host cordon. I'll be on standby and will execute fast-unwind if threshold hit.

deploybot: Canary health update: latency 85ms, p50 70ms, errors 0.6%. Observability dashboards: https://grafana.company/r/canary-v2-14-3. Proceeding to 10% traffic.

maria: Moving to 50% next. Reminder: pin criteria PR #678 landed; release notes posted: https://docs/releases/2.14.3. Keep an eye on KV cache metrics.

tony: Heads-up — there is a minor KV cache flush race on older nodes; mitigation in runbook step 3 (staggered prefix flip). If we see a cache-miss spike revert to pinned artifact v2.14.2 and cordon canary hosts.

nina: Observed a small miss-rate blip at 23:12 — spike to 1.8% then back down. Within our alarm threshold for now. Watching for recurrence.

deploybot: Traffic ramp to 50% complete. Health: latency 110ms, errors 1.2%. Snippet from canary logs:
```
[23:12:44] WARN cache_prefetcher - miss_rate=0.018, backend_latency=42ms
[23:12:45] INFO request_router - routed 1200 reqs to canary pool
```

sam: If errors > 2% or p95 latency > 150ms for 3 consecutive minutes we run backout. Otherwise continue to full rollout after 30m stable.

maria: 30m passed. We just saw a service-retry spike at 23:45 that nudged error budget. Nina — recommend pin or continue?

nina: Recommend pin and fast unwind. Plan: 1) set config pin -> v2.14.2, 2) cordon and scale down canary nodes, 3) revert cache-prefix migration, 4) open hotfix branch for the race. I can run pin and cordon now unless objections.

tony: +1 to pin. I'll prepare hotfix branch and a short PR for the cache backstop.

deploybot: Action: pin initiated by nina. Pin marker set in config-store (ops/configs/service-pin -> v2.14.2). Notifying downstream services. Backout runbook executed: https://internal/runbooks/fast-unwind.

maria: Thanks team. Filing a short incident note and will amend release notes with the postmortem breadcrumbs. Ping @release-czar for release note edit.

release-czar-bot: Release-czar: Noted. Will update the release notes, add backout summary and link to runbook. Will also schedule a 1-hour postmortem sync tomorrow. :calendar:
